summary: Endorse the one who beat you: {winner} beat you for the nomination and asks for your endorsement, with a role in it for you.
realLife: One life: He endorsed Trump weeks after quitting the 2016 race and led his transition until he was replaced after the bridge convictions. Another: In January 2008 he endorsed Barack Obama while his 2004 running mate, John Edwards, was still in the race. Another: After losing the 2010 primary he called the winner, Joe Sestak, and endorsed him; Sestak lost in November. Another: After quitting the 2024 race he declined to endorse the man he had served as vice president.
gates: You lost a primary or a nomination to {winner} on record.

branches.then: You run their transition. When your old aides are convicted you are dropped, and your people are purged (C44).
{old running mate} is still running and hears it from the news.
You are the first in your position to refuse in decades.
